item.text:
## Nettle CI Black Friday campaign recap

The campaign ran from **Saturday 21 November through Sunday 29 November, UK time**, targeting teams in the UK and Ireland.

- **Spend:** $463.44 of the $500 cap
- **Impressions:** 301,610
- **Link clicks:** 177

The campaign has expired. X did not track sign-ups because there was no pixel, so these results can’t show how many clicks became sign-ups. The first approved post ID wasn’t returned by the account lookup; the other three were accepted and promoted.
